turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My husband snoozes his alarm five times. I wake up at every single one.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's maddening. Could he set one alarm for the real time and put his phone across the room?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm running a little coffee cart at the farmers market this summer and I want one signature drink.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Love that. A honey lavender latte would feel special and floral, or a maple cold brew would be great on hot mornings. Which way are you leaning?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What I really want is— hang on, my dad's calling me over. Don't say anything.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Emma, have you seen my charger? The white one with the short cable.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I borrowed it this morning, sorry. It's next to my bed.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I grab it? I'm down to five percent.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Go for it. We really need to buy a second one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Agreed. Maybe a long cable so it reaches the couch.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Good idea. Add it to the shopping list.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Emma, did you hear that noise?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I think it was the neighbors.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All sorted, Moshi. Pick up where you were.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Your coffee cart drink. Lavender latte or maple cold brew?
